v11-5.candidate: Behold, Saul was coming from the field after the morning. Saul said, “Why are the people weeping?” They recounted to him the words of Jabesh’s sons.

v11-10.candidate: Jabesh’s men said to Nahash the Ammonite, “Tomorrow we will come out to you all, and you may do to us what is good before you.”

v12-2.candidate: Now behold, the king walks before you. I have grown old and will sit down, and my sons are here among you. Behold, I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

v12-9.candidate: They forgot the Lord their God, and He sold them into the hands of Sisera, commander-in-chief of Jabin king of Hazor, into the foreigners’ hands, and into the hands of Moab’s king. And they fought against them.

v12-19.candidate: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray to the Lord your God for your servants, and we will certainly not die. For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking a king for ourselves.”

v12-22.candidate: For the Lord will not reject His people for His great name’s sake, because the Lord graciously took you to Himself as a people.
